newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian navy evacuates 10 from Albania's Vlore.
newsitem.headline: Italian navy evacuates 10 from Albania's Vlore.

text.p: Italy said it had evacuated 10 people -- six Italians, two Albanians, one German and one American -- from the troubled southern Albanian port of Vlore on Monday.
It was the third such mission Italy has carried out over the past week.
An Italian Navy helicopter, based on the ship San Giorgio, airlifted 10 evacuees to the Italian port of Brindisi, just across the Adriatic Sea, the foreign ministry said.

The ministry said the operation had been carried out jointly by the defence and foreign ministries and with the authorisation of the Albanian government. It did not immediately release the names of those evacuated on Monday.
The airlift followed the evacuation from Vlore on Saturday of 33 Italians and Albanians and another 35 people on March 3, after armed rebels mounted an insurrection in southern Albania.
